194	**(h) Global induction: every `Init` leaf of a reached state was declared or written.**
195	MISSING. To prove, over an execution `s₀ = S3.init statics, s₁, …, sₙ` with `Step k sᵢ sᵢ₊₁`: if `sₙ.I l = .init` then either (declared: `∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true`, and `sᵢ.I l = .init` for all `i`) or (∃ i, `WrittenBy k sᵢ sᵢ₊₁ l` and `sⱼ.I l = .init` for all `j > i`). Proof: induction on the execution; at each step either `sᵢ.I l = .init` (induction hypothesis) or `init_only_by_writes`; base case `init_statics`. Stating it for every execution (not one witness execution) needs executions as data (5.1/5.2).
196	
197	**(i) Correspondence between `Step` and `Reachable`.**
198	Partial: `reachable_step` HandlePool.lean:530, `Steps`/`reachable_steps` HandlePool.lean:556/570. MISSING: `Reachable k statics s → <statics premise> ∧ Steps k (S3.init statics) s`, and the iff. Definitional if `Reachable` is the closure of `Step` (item 4); with a labelled step (5.2), also `Step k s s' ↔ ∃ o, OpStep k o s (.ok s')`, which v0.4 Annex F.5 asks for ("la liaison des constructeurs et transitions opérationnelles générales").
199	
200	**Reusability under the planned kernel changes** (arenas and `callParams` out of `S3`; enter locals owned by the frame; alloc one root; §63.8 in transfer; WF3 gains §49.3, §49.4, §49.7):
201	- As is (field removal only): `effective_compat`, `effective_exclusive`, `shared_keeps_exclusivity`, `write3_exclusive`, `call_params_effective_protected`, `noOrphan_of_rootLive` with `chain_to_frame`, `rootLive_cover`, `dropLoops*`, `linked_*`; `read3_preserves`; `KStep.active_back`; `init_statics`; `exitFrame_releases_all`, `exitFrame_kills_locals`, `exitFrame_kills_owned`, `exitFrame_reanchors_to_origin`, `dependent_cannot_escape_frame`, `exit_root_survives`; AnchorOrder/NoDangling/AnchorOrderHeld lemmas of derive, split, release, depend, write3, pin, endUse, free (except the two NoDangling root cases in 3b).
202	- Small edits: every `*_rootLive` and `RootLive.transport` (mode), `init_rootLive`, `init_only_by_writes`, `enter_params_protected`, `reachable_*` (cases removed), `step_inv57`.
203	- Extended: every `*_preserves` WF3 lemma (three new clauses).
204	- Reproof: `exitFrame_no_dangling`, `exit_preserves_noDangling` (+ I1), `endUse_preserves_noDangling`, `free_preserves_noDangling` (root case); `transfer_preserves`, `transfer_usable_fwd`, `transfer_preserves_noDangling` (P1); enter and alloc lemmas (simplified effects).
205	- Delete: arena lemmas in the kernel module, `CallProtects` family, draft `RootHeld` lemmas.
206	- New: ownership well-foundedness per operation, FpLeaves port, active-root uniqueness lemma, `reachable_iff_steps`, initialisation history, §59.b anchor theorem (after P4).
207	
208	---
209	
210	## 4. Spec problems
211	
212	**P1 (blocking for (a)/(b)): a `transfer` accepted by §63 breaks §49.8 and `NoDangling`.**
213	Passages: §63 effect "places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`"; §63.7 "All moved held authorities … satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state"; §44 "`AnchorOrder` requires, for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a **usable** place `q` … `AnchorOrderHeld` imposes the same rule on every active authority held by `q`"; §63.8 (local check on leaves of `corr(r)` only); §49.8 "every active authority is held by a frame present in the stack or by a usable place"; §49 "Preservation of `WF3` by a transition is a required property of transitions"; §58 "An `ok` transition must … preserve the relevant invariants"; §40 "An ownership cycle makes no place usable."
214	Example (`check/Cyc.lean`, every step `ok` in the draft and reached): frame 1 with locals `src` (0) and `prov` (1); `write3 prov`; `alloc(prov, one leaf, owner = src)` gives place 2 owned by `src`, root authority 2 held by `src`; `alloc(prov, one leaf, owner = 2)` gives place 3 owned by 2, root 3 held by 2; `write3 src`; then `transfer(src, 3)`.
215	§63.1–§63.8 hold: both usable, exercisable `Modify` on 0 (root 0) and on 3 (root 3 via root 2 via root 0); same shape (single leaves); `src` Init, 3 Uninit, disjoint; no pins, no anchors; authority 2 (held by part `src`) moves to `corr(src) = 3` and its footprint `[2]` contains no leaf of 3 (§63.8); in the result place 3 is not usable, so `AnchorOrderHeld` is vacuous for it. Lean confirms every draft `TransferPre` clause except the draft-only `(transferEff s src dst).Usable dst` (MM03:1247).
216	Result: place 2 is owned by 3 and 3 by 2; authority 2 is active, held by the unusable place 3 (§49.8 false) and covers leaf 2 of the unusable place 2 (`NoDangling` false); under the global reading of §49.3 (P3) the cycle also violates WF3.3. The draft rejects the step only through its own clause, which has no spec text. Not a charter §4.1 violation (authorities 2 and 3 are no longer exercisable: `ExercisableAt` is inductive and the holder chain is cyclic; the storage leaks, which charter §4.1 permits), but the §57 guarantee is false for the spec as written. Needed decision: e.g. require the destination usable in the resulting state, or read §63.7 as requiring every moved authority's new holder to have a frame.
217	
218	**P2: well-formedness of the declared statics is not stated (§47, §57).**
219	§47: "a static may also be owned by another static, in which case its root authority is held by the latter." Nothing excludes cycles or a part owned differently from its parent. Example (`check/Stat.lean`): statics 0 owned by 1 and 1 owned by 0: in `S3.init`, authority 0 is active and held by place 1, and places 0 and 1 are unusable, so §49.8 fails in the initial state and "reachable ⇒ WF3" (§57) is false. The draft adds `ShapeOK` (owners and parents are earlier statics, a part has its parent's owner) as a premise of `Reachable.init`; it is a representation of "well-formed declaration" only if the spec says statics are well-formed.
220	
221	**P3: scope of "well-founded" in §49.3.**
222	"valid owners of type frame or place, and **well-founded** ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place" reads either (A) all ownership chains are well-founded, and those of usable places reach a live frame, or (B) for every usable place, its chain is well-founded and reaches a live frame. Under (B) the clause is implied by the inductive `Usable` and adds nothing; under (A) the state `DraftGaps.wf_cyc` (MM23.lean:3899, two places owning each other, no authority) violates WF3. v0.4 FR "des chaînes de possession bien fondées, qui atteignent un cadre vivant pour chaque emplacement utilisable" leans to (A); MM23_v0.1.md (f) 6 used (A). The planned "WF3 gains well-founded ownership" presupposes (A). Under (A), P1 also breaks WF3.3.
223	
224	**P4: §59.b anchor list vs §69 effect.**
225	§59: "Access operations do not change an anchor without an explicitly authorized effect of transfer, `depend`, `store`, release, or reanchoring." §69 effect: "dependencies of the ended value are removed" while "`place` **remains usable as a place**". Example: `store a p` gives `D(p) = [a]`; `endUse p` makes `D(p) = []` with `p` usable (draft `endUseS` MM03:3937 does this). If "access operations" means all kernel operations, §59 forbids what §69 prescribes (endUse is not in the list; nor is the clearing of `D` by `free`, draft `freeS` MM03:4101, which §70 does not state). If it means O9–O11 only, there is no conflict. The statement of a §59 anchor theorem depends on the reading.
226	
227	**P5: "valid origin" in §51 is undefined, and decides whether `endUse` preserves I2.**
228	§51: "Every active authority is linked to a valid origin according to state and reanchoring rules." §44 defines validity for anchors only ("valid as long as the authority it names is active"). Example (`check/EU.lean`, reached): frame 1 locals X (0, Init) and p (1); derive 2 from root 0 on X (`Modify`); `store 2 p`; derive 3 from 2 on X (held by frame 1). `endUse p`: §69.2 concerns descendants "over the leaves of `place` or storage that dies with it" (3 covers X, which does not die), §69.3 holds once `p`'s dependencies are removed, §69.4 no pins; so the spec accepts it, and the effect releases 2 (held by `p`) while 3 stays active with origin 2 inactive. If "valid origin" means active, I2 fails after an accepted step; if it means existing, I2 holds, and the draft's extra `EndUseAccessOK` disjunct "`∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, EndUseReleased s p a`" (MM03:3979), which rejects this step (Lean confirms the rejection comes from that disjunct only), has no spec text. Primarily for the §51/§69 maps; it decides the endUse case of (a).
229	
230	**P6 (silence): the footprint of a root authority is never stated.**
231	§40 "Every root place has a root authority of own mode `Modify`, with no origin, held exactly by that place's owner"; §47, §49.6–7, §71, §72 never say it covers `footprint(r)`. The draft fixes `footprint (P) r` (`S3.init`, `enterEff`, `allocEff`, `RootLive`, `RootChain`). A smaller footprint would change accepted programs (`HasRight` on fresh storage fails) and makes `NoOrphan` underivable from `WF3` (`chain_to_frame` uses `z.footprint = footprint r`). The natural reading is `footprint(r)`; it needs confirmation, not a choice.
232	
233	No contradiction with the charter found in this scope (P1 produces a leak and broken invariants, not an exercisable access).
234	
235	---
236	
237	## 5. Representation choices (no accepted program changes)
238	
239	1. `Reachable` as the closure of one `Step` relation (`init` + `step`), `Step` = the ok-outcomes of O1–O16; `read` keeps the state. Makes (i) definitional.
240	2. Labelled steps: `inductive Op` (as HandlePool.lean:1535) and `OpStep k : Op → S3 → Outcome → Prop`, `Step k s s' := ∃ o, OpStep k o s (.ok s')`; `WrittenBy` keyed on the executed `o`; executions as lists of `(Op, S3)` for (h).
241	3. `WF3`, `Inv3`, and every operation precondition as `structure`s with named fields citing §49.n / §6x.n, replacing positional `∧` chains (`hpre.2.2.2…`), so that adding §63.8 or §49 clauses does not break unrelated proofs.
242	4. Keep index ordering for acyclicity of origins (`a < b`) and composition (`r < q`) (§49 last para).
243	5. §49.3 as `∀ q < s.P.length, ∃ f, FrameOf s q f` (inductive, so finite chains) once P3 is settled; §49.4 as `FpLeaves`; §49.7 as `RootLive` with `z.mode = .modify`.
244	6. Fresh locals and fresh allocation leaves start `Uninit` (§71 explicit; for §72, forced by §59 and §41 "`Moved`: value consumed by transfer").
245	7. Keep `nF` (fresh frame identities), `dead`, `freed`, `pin` as auxiliary state (§38 "auxiliary information that creates no new rights").
246	8. `effective_exclusive`, `effective_compat`, `call_params_effective_protected` stay stated on arbitrary states under I1 alone.
247	9. Statics as a well-formed shape list with Boolean init flags (draft `Statics` MM03:5461), pending P2.
248	
249	Skipped: I did not audit the §51–§54 definitions beyond what the §57 conjunction needs, nor the transfer/endUse/free/alloc preconditions beyond P1/P5; the Lean checks ran against the October 30 draft oleans in `formal/.lake`, assumed to match the branch head of MM03.lean.

545	**SP3. Scope of `free`'s preconditions vs. its effect.** Passages:
546	- §70.3 "footprint being freed", "released region".
547	- §70.4 "No leaf of the released unit".
548	- The effect: "`place` and the storage that ceases to live are marked dead".
549	- By contrast, §69.4 and §73.3 say explicitly "including transitively owned storage".
550	
551	Example (probe E7): `q` (allocated, owned by local `v`) owns `q2`; `pin(q2)`; `free(q)`. Literal 70.4: `q2` is
552	not a leaf of the released unit `q`, so `ok`, and `q2` dies while pinned. The draft rejects. The same scoping
553	question decides corpus H15 ("`free` of a storage whose owned sub-storage is the origin of an access held
554	elsewhere", expected `reject`). That verdict requires "footprint being freed" in 70.3 to include the dying owned
555	storage; with the narrow reading, the access is silently deactivated by the effect instead.
556	
557	**SP4. Identity of dynamic pinning obligations.** Passages:
558	- §74 "A dynamic pinning obligation is installed on the relevant leaves. While it is active, … rejected if they
559	  act on leaves it pins".
560	- §75 "The corresponding dynamic pinning obligation ends".
561	
562	The spec does not say whether obligations are counted per `pin` call, per place, or per leaf, nor what
563	`unpin(p)` ends when `p` was never pinned or was pinned through a larger place. Example (probe E2): struct `S`
564	with fields `f1`, `f2`; `pin(S)`; `pin(f1)`; `unpin(f1)` under `ExternalDone(f1)`. Is `f1` still pinned by
565	`pin(S)`'s obligation? Per §74, yes, so `transfer(f1, d)` must be rejected; the draft (one `Bool` per leaf)
566	accepts it. `unpin(f1)` with no prior pin is accepted by the draft. These are the representation choices of C11,
567	which change accepted programs.
568	
569	**SP5. §74 "and the operation respects applicable pinning obligations" is undefined.** Neither §74, §80
570	(`Pinned`: "I5, prohibition of incompatible physical moves; `StaticPinnedBottom` for pinned statics") nor §57
571	(I5 is "a specialized obligation of `K.Pinned`") names a condition that could reject a `pin`. As written the
572	clause is either vacuous or unformalizable; the draft omits it.
573	
574	**SP6. Domain of `K.Pinned`.** Passages:
575	- §75: "Statics designated by `K.Pinned` must be places directly owned by the base frame".
576	- §63.5, §69.4, §70.4, §73.3 use `K.Pinned` on any leaf ("statically (`K.Pinned`)").
577	
578	The spec does not say whether `K.Pinned` may designate a non-static leaf. Example: `K.Pinned` on a leaf of a
579	local of frame 1. 73.3 then rejects every exit of frame 1, and `StaticPinnedBottom` says nothing. The draft's
580	`StaticPinnedBottom` (5939) quantifies over every `K.Pinned` leaf, so it excludes such a `K`.
581	
582	**SP7. "type and storage contract" in O9.3 / O10.3 is not part of `K`.** Passages:
583	- §66.3 "the type and storage contract permits this read".
584	- §67.3 "constraints of the relevant types, storage, and abstractions remain valid".
585	- §48: "`K` contains the predicates `DeclaredDisjoint`, `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`,
586	  `Deallocable`, `FreeCompat`, and `Satisfiable`".
587	- §20.3 (memory machine): obligations "are not tacitly replaced by `True`".
588	
589	No predicate, signature or owner is given for this contract. Formalizing it needs a parameter the spec does not
590	name, and dropping it makes `read3`/`write3` more permissive than the rule. The draft drops it ("not
591	represented").
592	
593	**SP8. `alloc` provider metadata (§71.2), and tension with §36.** Passage §71.2: "updates to its metadata are
594	permitted through exercisable `Modify` or a valid `writeShared` over `SharedMutable` metadata".
595	- (a) Which provider leaves are "metadata" is unspecified. Probe E8: a provider with fields `m`
596	  (`SharedMutable`) and `c`, under an `Observe` right. Reading "metadata = `m`" gives `ok`; reading "all
597	  leaves" gives `reject` (the draft).
598	- (b) §36: "Shared mutation of metadata does not, however, grant the right to create … exclusive authority over
599	  the administered storage", and "Allocation through administration shared among simultaneous holders, under an
600	  interface not providing such exclusive exercise, cannot be expressed in safe code with only these sequential
601	  operations". Yet §71.2 lets `alloc` create a new exclusive root through only an `Observe` right over
602	  `SharedMutable` provider metadata. Probe E8b: `¬ HasRight Modify provider`, and `alloc` is `ok`.
603	
604	The spec must say whether §36 constrains the provider of O14 or only library abstractions (arenas, `HandlePool`,
605	`DataStack`). The task note "spec v0 §36 … the `writeShared` branch alone is insufficient" concerns `MetaRight`;
606	§71.2 keeps the disjunction in v0.
607	
608	**SP9. §73.2 "Results that must survive have already been legally transferred to their destinations" cannot be
609	formalized in `S3`.** `S3` (§38) records no result obligation; §45 places the result place among the
610	`Modify` parameters, and calling conventions are deferred to Spec 3. Example: a callee writes its result into a
611	local and exits. Nothing in the kernel state distinguishes that local from a temporary, so the clause is
612	vacuous in the kernel. The draft has no counterpart.
613	
614	**SP10. §72.2 "Modes, footprints, anchoring, and parameter-passing rules permit this change of holder" has no
615	checkable content.** "Parameter-passing rules" belong to Spec 3 (§45). Anchoring is covered by 72.4, and modes
616	and footprints do not change. As written the clause cannot be formalized; the draft treats it as vacuous.
617	
618	**SP11 (cross-scope, §43, affects §69.1, §70.3, §71.2, §71.3, §74, §75). `HasRight` quantifier order.**
619	Passage §43: "`HasRight(s,m,p)` means the current frame has exercise in mode `m` and sufficient effective mode
620	**over every leaf in `p`'s footprint**". Readings: one authority for all leaves (∃∀, the draft, 877) or one per
621	leaf (∀∃). Example (probe E5): `split(root S, [[f1],[f2]])`. Then `HasRight Modify f1` and
622	`HasRight Modify f2` hold, `HasRight Modify S` does not (draft), and `pin(S)` is `reject`. Under ∀∃, `pin(S)`
623	is `ok`.
624	
625	**SP12 (minor, editorial). §59 vs §69 effect.** §59: "Access operations do not change an anchor without an
626	explicitly authorized effect of transfer, `depend`, `store`, release, or reanchoring". §69: "dependencies of the
627	ended value are removed", and `place` stays usable, so the change is observable by I3 and `AnchorOrder`.
628	`endUse` is not in §59's list. §69 is the specific rule; the list should name it.
629	
630	---
631	
632	## 5. Representation choices (change no accepted program)
633	
634	- **R1.** One `Outcome3 σ := ok σ | reject | fail` (§58), with `fail` carrying no state ("leaving the state
635	  unchanged"). All O1–O16 except `alloc` stay `Guarded` (ok/reject). Removes `AOutcome`.
636	- **R2.** `S3` without `arenas` (§38: "Administrative states of arenas and other library abstractions are
637	  separate from `S₃`"). No operation in this scope reads or writes them. `freed` and `callParams` may stay as
638	  auxiliary data (§38 "auxiliary information that creates no new rights"). Each must be documented as read by no
639	  precondition (`freed` is read by MM23 `Repr` only).
640	- **R3.** "Required anchors" (66.3), "Anchors" (67.3), "Dependencies" (68.3): keep `DepsValid` (the anchors of
641	  the leaf and of every place containing it). On every state satisfying I3 and 66.1a usability, every reading of
642	  "required anchors" that names anchors of usable places is implied. State this as a lemma, not a silent choice.
643	- **R4.** 69.3 "remaining usable after the effect depends on": read on the post-`endUseS` usability and `D`, as
644	  the draft does. The pre-state reading would reject every `endUse` of a value holding a stored authority,
645	  because `store` adds it to `D(target)` and the effect removes it. Report the reading in the docstring.
646	- **R5.** "Exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`" (68.2) as `ExercisableAt a .observe`, with the lemma
647	  `ExercisableAt a .modify → ExercisableAt a .observe`.
648	- **R6.** `free`'s "exercisable `Modify`" (70.3) is read over `place`.
649	- **R7.** Shapes: local shape `List (Option Nat × Nat)` (relative parent index, kind); alloc shape = local shape
650	  with a single root at index 0; static shape keeps the owning element and the init flag (§47). Parent indices
651	  relative to the shape avoid offset arithmetic (`ShapeOK n`). Identities stay list indices (§49 allows numerical
652	  ordering as representation).
653	- **R8.** Frame identities: the base frame is identity 0 (§39 "whose identity is 0 in states reachable from the
654	  initial state"). Use `0` in `StaticPinnedBottom` and in 73.1 instead of the stack bottom; they are equal on
655	  reachable states (`reachable_base_owns_statics`).
656	- **R9.** `exitFrame` keeps `dead` unchanged; locals become unusable through the owner chain (§73 says "become
657	  unusable", not "marked dead"). `Survives`/`firstSurv` as in the draft.
658	- **R10.** Drop the provider `I` update in `allocEff`. It is a no-op under 71.2a and removes an apparent write
659	  from J1 accounting.

1	import Ern.MM02
2	
3	/-!
4	# MM-03.3 v0.2: kernel of the access discipline (exploratory model, milestone 1, pass 3)
5	
6	Abstract layer of `formal/DESIGN.md` ("Abstract model"): memory is a finite tree of places.
7	Refinement towards MM-02 (MM-03.3 §9) is milestone 2 and is not treated here; the module
8	imports `Ern.MM02` without using or changing it. Covered fragment: sequential execution of the
9	kernel operations (MM-03.3 §3–5) and of the arena (§6); no concurrency, no persistent handles.
10	
11	Pass 2 follows arbitrages A1–A11 of the task: authorities are held by a frame or a place (A4),
12	places are owned by a frame or a place (A5), rights are exercised through `ExercisableAt` (A2, B2),
13	values end by `endUse` and owned storage is released by `free` (A6). Pass 3 adds arbitrages
14	B1–B10: two clauses of `WF3` (B1) and the clause `AnchorOrder` of `Inv3` (B8).
15	-/
16	
17	namespace Ern.MM03
18	
19	/-! ## Frames (MM-03.3.1) -/
20	
21	/-- Frame stack `F` (MM-03.3.1): frame identities, current frame first. The parent of a frame
22	is the next element; the last element is the initial frame. -/
23	abbrev Frames := List Nat
24	
25	/-- `ancestor F f₁ f₂` (MM-03.3.1): `f₁` is `f₂` itself or one of its ancestors in `F`, that is,
26	`f₁` occurs in `F` from the first occurrence of `f₂` on. -/
27	def ancestor (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop := f₁ ∈ F.dropWhile (· != f₂)
28	
29	instance (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (ancestor F f₁ f₂) :=
30	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∈ _))

32	/-! ## Parent chains
33	
34	Places (by `parent`) and authorities (by `origin`) form forests whose identities are indices.
35	A chain only follows a link to a strictly smaller index; the fuel `k` only ensures
36	termination. -/
37	
38	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first. -/
39	def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
40	  | 0, _ => []
41	  | k + 1, i =>
42	    match org i with
43	    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
44	    | none => []
45	
46	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (fuel `i`, enough since the chain decreases). -/
47	def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i
48	
49	theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
50	    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []
51	  | 0 => rfl
52	  | _ + 1 => by simp [chainF, h]
53	
54	theorem chainF_fuel (org : Nat → Option Nat) :
55	    ∀ k₁ k₂ i, i ≤ k₁ → i ≤ k₂ → chainF org k₁ i = chainF org k₂ i
56	  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
57	  | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
58	    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
59	    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
60	  | _ + 1, 0, i, _, h => by
61	    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
62	    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
63	  | k₁ + 1, k₂ + 1, i, h₁, h₂ => by
64	    simp only [chainF]; split
65	    · split
66	      · rw [chainF_fuel org k₁ k₂ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
67	      · rfl
68	    · rfl
69	
70	theorem chain_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) : chain org i = [] :=
71	  chainF_none h i
72	
73	theorem chain_cons {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i o : Nat} (h : org i = some o) (hlt : o < i) :
74	    chain org i = o :: chain org o := by
75	  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
76	  simp only [chain, chainF, h, hlt, ↓reduceIte]
77	  rw [chainF_fuel org k o o (by omega) (Nat.le_refl o)]
78	
79	theorem chainF_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i j, j ∈ chainF org k i → j < i
80	  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
81	  | k + 1, i, j, h => by
82	    simp only [chainF] at h; split at h
83	    · split at h
84	      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
85	        · assumption
86	        · exact Nat.lt_trans (chainF_lt k _ j h) ‹_›
87	      · simp at h
88	    · simp at h
89	
90	/-- Every element of a chain is strictly smaller than its start: the walk along a chain
91	terminates (A7). -/
92	theorem chain_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i j : Nat} (h : j ∈ chain org i) : j < i :=
93	  chainF_lt i i j h
94	
95	theorem chainF_length {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i, (chainF org k i).length ≤ k
96	  | 0, _ => by simp [chainF]
97	  | k + 1, i => by
98	    simp only [chainF]; split
99	    · split
100	      · simp only [List.length_cons]; have := chainF_length (org := org) k ‹_›; omega
101	      · simp
102	    · simp
103	
104	/-- A chain from `i` has at most `i` elements (A7: termination of the walk). -/
105	theorem chain_length (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : (chain org i).length ≤ i :=
106	  chainF_length i i
107	
108	theorem chainF_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} :
109	    ∀ k i, (∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) → chainF org k i = chainF org' k i
110	  | 0, _, _ => rfl
111	  | k + 1, i, h => by
112	    simp only [chainF]; rw [h i (Nat.le_refl i)]; split
113	    · split
114	      · rw [chainF_congr k _ fun j hj => h j (by omega)]
115	      · rfl
116	    · rfl
117	
118	theorem chain_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : ∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) :
119	    chain org i = chain org' i := chainF_congr i i h
120	
121	/-- Two roots (elements without link) of one chain are equal. -/
122	theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →
123	    r' ∈ chainF org k i → org r' = none → r = r'
124	  | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h
125	  | k + 1, i, r, r', h, hr, h', hr' => by
126	    simp only [chainF] at h h'; split at h
127	    · rename_i o ho; simp only [ho] at h'
128	      split at h
129	      · rename_i hlt; simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h'
130	        rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h'
131	        · rfl
132	        · rw [chainF_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
133	        · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h
134	        · exact chainF_root k _ r r' h hr h' hr'
135	      · simp at h
136	    · simp at h

138	/-! ## Places (MM-03.3.2, A5) -/
139	
140	/-- Holder of an authority (A4) or owner of a place (A5): a frame or a place. -/
141	inductive Holder where
142	  | frame (f : Nat)
143	  | place (p : Nat)
144	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
145	
146	/-- Logical place (MM-03.3.2: `Place { id, parent?, frame, kind }`). Its identity is its index
147	in `P`. The field `frame` of MM-03.3.2 is generalised by `owner` (A5): a place is owned by a
148	frame or by another place (owned storage). A part has the owner of its parent (`WF3`). `kind`
149	is not interpreted: MM-03.3.2 gives no values for it. -/
150	structure Place where
151	  parent : Option Nat
152	  owner : Holder
153	  kind : Nat
154	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
155	
156	/-- `parent` link of the place with index `i` (MM-03.3.2). -/
157	def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)
158	
159	/-- `partOf P p q` (MM-03.3.2, logical composition): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` itself
160	or one of its ancestors along `parent`. -/
161	def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
162	  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)
163	
164	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
165	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
166	
167	/-- Storage leaf (MM-03.3.2): a place without a strict part. -/
168	def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l
169	
170	instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
171	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))
172	
173	/-- `footprint P q` (MM-03.3.2): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
174	def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
175	  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)
176	
177	/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (MM-03.3.2). -/
178	def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q
179	
180	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
181	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))
182	
183	/-- Structural disjointness (MM-03.3.2): neither path is a part of the other. -/
184	def structurallyDisjoint (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ¬ partOf P p q ∧ ¬ partOf P q p
185	
186	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (structurallyDisjoint P p q) :=
187	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
188	
189	theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
190	    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
191	  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]
192	
193	theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
194	    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
195	  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
196	  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

198	/-! ## State `S3` (MM-03.3 §1) -/
199	
200	/-- Initialisation state of a leaf (MM-03.3.3). -/
201	inductive InitSt where
202	  | uninit
203	  | init
204	  | moved
205	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
206	
207	/-- Mode of an authority (MM-03.3.4). -/
208	inductive Mode where
209	  | observe
210	  | modify
211	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
212	
213	/-- Order of modes: `Observe` does not exceed `Modify` (MM-03.3.4: `Modify` allows
214	modifications and observations). -/
215	def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify
216	
217	instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))
218	
219	/-- Authority (MM-03.3.4: `Authority { id, mode, origin?, footprint, frame, active }`). Its
220	identity is its index in `A`; its footprint is a list of leaves; no `Suspended` status is
221	stored. The field `frame` of MM-03.3.4 is generalised by `holder` (A4): a frame or the place
222	whose value contains the authority. -/
223	structure Authority where
224	  mode : Mode
225	  origin : Option Nat
226	  footprint : List Nat
227	  holder : Holder
228	  active : Bool
229	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
230	
231	/-- An arena entry (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1): `storage` is the place of the administered storage;
232	`internal` is the authority that administers it, named by `newArena` (F1); `available` and
233	`issued` are the logical state of §6, `issued` mapping each issued region to the issued block.
234	The arena value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (F1), which follows
235	transfers (A4). The anchor of §6 is not a field either: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
236	structure Arena where
237	  storage : Nat
238	  internal : Nat
239	  available : List Nat
240	  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
241	deriving DecidableEq
242	
243	/-- State `S3 = (F, P, I, A, D)` (MM-03.3 §1), without component `M` (pass-1 arbitrage 1).
244	`nF` is the next frame identity, so that an exited frame is never reused. `D q` lists the
245	anchors of place `q`, each an authority identity (pass-1 arbitrage 2). `dead q`: the place is
246	logically dead (A6, `endUse` and `free`); `freed q`: its storage was released by `free` (A6);
247	`pin l`: leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (A8). `arenas`: the arena entries registered by
248	`newArena` (D3). `callParams f`: the parameters given to frame `f` by `enterFrame`, a ghost record
249	(F6): set by `enterFrame`, never modified, read by no operation. -/
250	structure S3 where
251	  F : Frames
252	  nF : Nat
253	  P : List Place
254	  I : Nat → InitSt
255	  A : List Authority
256	  D : Nat → List Nat
257	  dead : Nat → Bool
258	  freed : Nat → Bool
259	  pin : Nat → Bool
260	  arenas : List Arena
261	  callParams : Nat → List Nat
262	
263	/-- Contracts `K` (MM-03.3.8) for an execution. Types are a representation choice: regions as
264	lists of leaves; `SharedMutable`, `Pinned` and `ExternalDone` on leaves; `Deallocable p` and
265	`FreeCompat p auth` for `free` (A6); `Satisfiable provider shape s` for `alloc` (B5; C9: it
266	depends on the current state `s`, with the shape encoded as the locals of `enterFrame`, C6).
267	`Invalidates` is removed (B9). The obligations of each contract are named hypotheses of theorems, never
268	fields. -/
269	structure K where
270	  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
271	  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
272	  Pinned : Nat → Prop
273	  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
274	  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
275	  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
276	  Satisfiable : Nat → List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) → S3 → Prop
277	
278	/-- Obligation of `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8): a declaration never covers two regions that
279	really overlap. -/
280	def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'
281	
282	/-- `origin` link of the authority with index `i` (MM-03.3.4). -/
283	def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
284	
285	/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along `origin`: `i` descends from each (MM-03.3.5). -/
286	def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i
287	
288	/-- Effective anchor of an anchor `x` (C1): the root of its chain of origins (`RootChain`), the
289	last element of `x :: s.ancs x`. -/
290	def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x
291	
292	/-- Active authority, that is, valid anchor (pass-1 arbitrage 2). -/
293	def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true
294	
295	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
296	  match h : s.A[x]? with
297	  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
298	    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
299	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'
300	
301	/-- Current frame: the head of the stack (MM-03.3.1). -/
302	def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

304	/-! ## Decidable helpers -/
305	
306	/-- Predicate on an optional value: `P y` for `some y`, `d` for `none`. -/
307	def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
308	  match o with
309	  | some y => P y
310	  | none => d
311	
312	instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
313	    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
314	  match o with
315	  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
316	  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)
317	
318	theorem lt_of_getElem? {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : l[i]? = some x) :
319	    i < l.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
320	
321	/-! ## Least fixed points on a bounded universe
322	
323	`Usable` (A5) and `ExercisableAt` (B2) are inductive predicates. Each is the least fixed point of
324	a monotone rule over identities below a bound `n`; its Kleene iteration is stable after `n + 1`
325	steps, which makes it decidable. -/
326	
327	/-- `k`-th Kleene iterate of a rule `R` on Boolean predicates over `Nat`. -/
328	def kiter (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Nat → Bool
329	  | 0, _ => false
330	  | k + 1, a => R (kiter R k) a
331	
332	/-- A monotone rule whose conclusions lie below `n` and which reads its premise only below
333	`n`. -/
334	structure KRule (n : Nat) (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Prop where
335	  mono : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, p a = true → q a = true) → ∀ a, R p a = true → R q a = true
336	  bound : ∀ p a, R p a = true → a < n
337	  loc : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, a < n → p a = q a) → ∀ a, R p a = R q a
338	
339	theorem kiter_mono {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
340	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + 1) a = true
341	  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
342	  | k + 1, a, hk => h.mono _ _ (kiter_mono h k) a hk
343	
344	theorem kiter_bound {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
345	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → a < n
346	  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
347	  | _ + 1, a, hk => h.bound _ a hk
348	
349	theorem countP_le_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true) :
350	    l.countP p ≤ l.countP q := by
351	  induction l with
352	  | nil => simp
353	  | cons a l ih =>
354	    simp only [List.countP_cons]
355	    have := ih fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
356	    cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega
357	
358	theorem countP_lt_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true)
359	    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ l) (hqx : q x = true) (hpx : p x = false) : l.countP p < l.countP q := by
360	  induction l with
361	  | nil => simp at hx
362	  | cons a l ih =>
363	    simp only [List.countP_cons]
364	    have hle := countP_le_of (l := l) fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
365	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
366	    · simp [hqx, hpx]; omega
367	    · have := ih (fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)) hx
368	      cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega
369	
370	theorem all_false_exists {α : Type} {p : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, l.all p = false →
371	    ∃ a ∈ l, p a = false
372	  | [], h => by simp at h
373	  | a :: l, h => by
374	    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at h
375	    rcases h with h | h
376	    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self .., h⟩
377	    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := all_false_exists h; exact ⟨b, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb, hb'⟩
378	
379	/-- Stability of the iteration at step `k`, below `n`. -/
380	def kstab (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) (n k : Nat) : Bool :=
381	  (List.range n).all fun a => kiter R (k + 1) a == kiter R k a
382	
383	theorem kstab_succ {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
384	    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : kstab R n (k + 1) = true := by
385	  simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs ⊢
386	  intro a ha
387	  show R (kiter R (k + 1)) a = R (kiter R k) a
388	  exact h.loc _ _ (fun b hb => hs b hb) a
389	
390	theorem kstab_le {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
391	    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : ∀ j, k ≤ j → kstab R n j = true
392	  | j, hj => by
393	    induction j with
394	    | zero => obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
395	              exact hs
396	    | succ j ih =>
397	      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (j + 1) with hlt | hge
398	      · exact kstab_succ h (ih (by omega))
399	      · obtain rfl : k = j + 1 := by omega
400	        exact hs
401	
402	theorem kstab_exists {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
403	    ∀ k, (∃ j, j < k ∧ kstab R n j = true) ∨ k ≤ (List.range n).countP (kiter R k)
404	  | 0 => .inr (Nat.zero_le _)
405	  | k + 1 => by
406	    rcases kstab_exists h k with hj | hc
407	    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ := hj; exact .inl ⟨j, by omega, hs⟩
408	    · cases hs : kstab R n k
409	      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hne⟩ := all_false_exists hs
410	        simp only [List.mem_range, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at ha hne
411	        have hk : kiter R k a = false := by
412	          cases e : kiter R k a
413	          · rfl
414	          · exact absurd (kiter_mono h k a e) (by rw [e] at hne; simpa using hne)
415	        have hk1 : kiter R (k + 1) a = true := by
416	          cases e : kiter R (k + 1) a
417	          · rw [e, hk] at hne; exact absurd rfl hne
418	          · rfl
419	        have := countP_lt_of (l := List.range n) (fun b _ hb => kiter_mono h k b hb)
420	          (List.mem_range.2 ha) hk1 hk
421	        exact .inr (by omega)
422	      · exact .inl ⟨k, by omega, hs⟩
423	
424	/-- The iteration is stable from step `n + 1` on. -/
425	theorem kiter_fix {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) (a : Nat) :
426	    kiter R (n + 2) a = kiter R (n + 1) a := by
427	  rcases kstab_exists h (n + 1) with ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ | hc
428	  · have hs' := kstab_le h hs (n + 1) (by omega)
429	    by_cases ha : a < n
430	    · simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs'
431	      exact hs' a ha
432	    · cases e : kiter R (n + 2) a
433	      · cases e' : kiter R (n + 1) a
434	        · rfl
435	        · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e') ha
436	      · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e) ha
437	  · have := List.countP_le_length (p := kiter R (n + 1)) (l := List.range n)
438	    simp at this; omega

440	/-! ## Usable places (MM-03.3.1, A5) -/
441	
442	/-- `s.Usable q` (A5): place `q` exists, is not logically dead, and the chain of its owners ends
443	at a frame on the stack. Inductive, so a cycle of owners never makes a place usable. -/
444	inductive S3.Usable (s : S3) : Nat → Prop where
445	  | frame {q f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
446	      pl.owner = .frame f → f ∈ s.F → S3.Usable s q
447	  | place {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
448	      pl.owner = .place o → S3.Usable s o → S3.Usable s q
449	
450	theorem S3.Usable.lt {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : q < s.P.length := by
451	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›

542	  | 0, _, _, hk => hk

546	    ∀ j, kiter R (n + 1 + j) = kiter R (n + 1)
547	  | 0 => rfl
548	  | j + 1 => funext fun a => by
549	    show R (kiter R (n + 1 + j)) a = kiter R (n + 1) a
550	    rw [kiter_ge h j]; exact kiter_fix h a

555	  intro k a hk
556	  by_cases hkn : k ≤ n + 1
557	  · have := kiter_mono_le h (n + 1 - k) k a hk
558	    rwa [show k + (n + 1 - k) = n + 1 by omega] at this
559	  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = n + 1 + j := ⟨k - (n + 1), by omega⟩
560	    rwa [kiter_ge h j] at hk

560	    rwa [kiter_ge h j] at hk

674	    | none => none

676	/-- Cases 1 to 3 of MM-03.3.5 for an active authority covering the leaf, of mode `m`, whose

678	def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
679	  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe

681	/-- `effective(a, p)` (MM-03.3.5), computed per leaf, with no stored status: absent if `a` is

683	def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=

741	authority held by `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of that authority is the frame of `q` or
742	one of its ancestors (`EffAnchorOK`, C1). -/

751	        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by

754	    unfold OptP; split
755	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy

757	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh

783	/-- `s.ExercisableAt a m` (B2): authority `a` is exercisable at mode `m` when `m` does not exceed its
784	mode and it is held by the current frame, or held by a place `p` such that an authority
785	exercisable at mode `m` has an effective mode permitting `m` on the whole footprint of `p`. The
786	authority is active: the rights of a released authority cannot be exercised (MM-03.3 §3, O3).
787	Inductive, so no cycle justifies a right. -/
788	inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
789	  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
790	      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
791	  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
792	      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
793	      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

797	  match s.A[a]? with
798	  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
799	    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
800	    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
801	        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
802	  | none => false

806	  | [], _ => rfl
807	  | a :: l, h => by
808	    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),

814	    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
815	      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
816	      · simpa using h.2
817	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
818	        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
819	        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
820	    · exact h

822	    unfold exR at h; split at h
823	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
824	    · cases h
825	  loc p q hpq a := by
826	    unfold exR; split
827	    · congr 1; split

829	      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]

886	/-- `Outcome3` (MM-03.3 §3): `ok` with the new state, or `reject`, refusal by the static
887	discipline, distinct from a defined failure of an abstraction and from `ub` of MM-02. -/
888	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
889	  | ok (s : σ)
890	  | reject

893	precondition holds, `reject` otherwise. -/
894	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
895	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
896	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

899	    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
900	  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction
901	
902	theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
903	    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
904	  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩
905	
906	theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
907	    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
908	  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

913	origin `src`, footprint `footprint place`, mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
914	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=

927	the effective authority of the origin on each leaf. O1.4 is removed (A11): it follows from the

933	  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m)

968	  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)

1020	/-- Children of the place `x` (MM-03.3.2), in index order. -/
1021	def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
1022	  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)
1023	
1024	/-- Position of `r` in a list (its length if absent). -/
1025	def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
1026	  | [] => 0
1027	  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1
1028	
1029	/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1), searched within `n` steps:
1030	`dst` for `src`; for another part, the child, at the same position among the children ordered by
1031	index, of the place that corresponds to its parent. -/
1032	def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
1033	  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
1034	  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
1035	      match parentOf P r with
1036	      | some p => if p < r then
1037	          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
1038	      | none => none
1039	
1040	/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1). -/
1041	def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r
1042	
1043	/-- J1, « `dst` a la même forme que `src` (sous-arbres isomorphes) »: every part of `src` has a
1044	corresponding part of `dst` with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part
1045	of `src`. Children are matched in index order (ordered isomorphism). -/
1046	def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
1047	  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
1048	    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
1049	  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
1050	    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z
1051	
1052	instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
1053	  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

1057	  | .place r => partOf P r q
1058	  | .frame _ => False

1072	ones included, join those of the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority

1075	part of the destination, without moving, and its root follows (A5, J1, `RootHeld`). -/

1078	    P := s.P.map fun pl =>

1085	      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

1102	    | some pl =>
1103	      match pl.owner with

1129	  | some pl => match pl.owner with

1135	  mono p q hpq a h := by
1136	    unfold owR at h ⊢; split at h
1137	    · split at h
1138	      · simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
1139	        rcases h with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
1140	        · exact .inl h
1141	        · exact .inr ⟨h1, hpq _ h2⟩
1142	      · exact h
1143	    · exact h
1144	  bound p a h := by
1145	    unfold owR at h; split at h
1146	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
1147	    · cases h
1148	  loc p q hpq a := by
1149	    unfold owR; split
1150	    · split
1151	      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < s.P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
1152	      · rfl
1153	    · rfl

1158	  | k + 1, q => by
1159	    simp only [ownedWithinF, kiter, owR]
1160	    split
1161	    · split
1162	      · rename_i o _
1163	        by_cases hlt : o < s.P.length
1164	        · simp [hlt, ownedWithinF_kiter s src k o]
1165	        · have : ownedWithinF s src k o = false := by
1166	            cases k with
1167	            | zero => rfl
1168	            | succ k => simp [ownedWithinF, List.getElem?_eq_none (Nat.le_of_not_lt hlt)]
1169	          simp [hlt, this]
1170	      · rfl
1171	    · rfl

1178	    split at h
1179	    · rename_i pl hpl
1180	      split at h
1181	      · rename_i o ho
1182	        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h

1226	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4), in order: source usable (MM-03.3.1) and
1227	1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source (F5:
1228	the footprints of source and destination are disjoint, the clause `¬ overlap`, redundant with
1229	clauses 1 and 2 by `transfer_overlap_redundant`),
1230	and still usable once it owns the source's storage (no ownership cycle); exercisable `Modify`
1231	on the source and on the destination (B2); 4 no active derived
1232	access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
1233	(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame, for the anchors of the value and of the usable
1234	places it owns, whose frame changes with it (A5), each frame read after the transfer (B7);
1235	7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
1236	(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8); B8 on the effective anchor (C1): for every dependent
1237	usable after the transfer, if its effective anchor moves with the value, or if the dependent
1238	itself moves (the destination, or a place the value owns), the frame of the effective anchor is
1239	the dependent's frame or an ancestor of it, both frames read after the transfer
1240	(`EffAnchorOK`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state, the whole predicate, for every held
1241	authority; J1: the destination has the shape of the source (`SameShape`). O4.3 holds by
1242	construction. -/
1243	def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
1244	  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
1245	  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
1246	  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
1247	  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
1248	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
1249	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
1250	  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
1251	    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
1252	  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
1253	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
1254	    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
1255	      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
1256	      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
1257	  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst
1258	
1259	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
1260	    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
1261	  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

1263	/-- The preconditions of `transfer` other than the shape of the destination (J1): `TransferPre`
1264	without its last clause (`transferPre_iff`). Used to show that a transfer is rejected by the shape
1265	clause alone. -/
1266	def TransferPreBase (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
1267	  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
1268	  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
1269	  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
1270	  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
1271	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
1272	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
1273	  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
1274	    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
1275	  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
1276	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
1277	    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
1278	      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
1279	      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
1280	  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst)
1281	
1282	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
1283	    Decidable (TransferPreBase k s src dst) := by
1284	  unfold TransferPreBase; infer_instance
1285	
1286	theorem transferPre_iff {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
1287	    TransferPre k s src dst ↔ TransferPreBase k s src dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst := by
1288	  unfold TransferPre TransferPreBase; simp only [and_assoc]

1290	/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
1291	def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=

1294	/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
1295	
1296	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
1297	the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
1298	by `depsOf`. -/
1299	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
1300	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
1301	
1302	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1303	1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
1304	of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
1305	(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
1306	to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
1307	def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
1308	  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
1309	    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
1310	
1311	instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
1312	  unfold DependPre; infer_instance

1314	/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
1315	def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=

1318	/-! ## F4 `store` -/
1319	
1320	/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
1321	place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
1322	def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
1323	  | some y => { s with
1324	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
1325	      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
1326	      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
1327	  | none => s
1328	
1329	/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
1330	by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
1331	of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
1332	anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
1333	of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
1334	active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
1335	`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
1336	`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
1337	operation exists (F4). -/
1338	def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
1339	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
1340	  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
1341	  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
1342	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
1343	  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
1344	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
1345	    True) ∧
1346	  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)
1347	
1348	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance
1349	
1350	/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
1351	def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1352	  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

1354	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/
1355	
1356	/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
1357	the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
1358	def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
1359	  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
1360	  | some o => .place o
1361	  | none => .frame f
1362	
1363	/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
1364	earlier local (A5). -/
1365	def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
1366	  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
1367	    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩
1368	
1369	/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
1370	def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
1371	  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone
1372	
1373	/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
1374	`nF` pushed; the parameters, held by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
1375	appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
1376	authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
1377	arbitrage 2; A4); the ghost record `callParams` of the new frame is `ps` (F6). -/
1378	def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
1379	  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
1380	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
1381	    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
1382	      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
1383	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
1384	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
1385	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
1386	    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
1387	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q
1388	    arenas := s.arenas
1389	    callParams := fun f => if f = s.nF then ps else s.callParams f }
1390	
1391	/-- G1, for one parameter `p` and the state `s'` where the new frame has received its parameters:
1392	if `p` is a `Modify` authority with an origin, that origin, its direct origin only, is
1393	exercisable (A2, B2) at no mode in `s'`. -/
1394	def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
1395	  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
1396	    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True
1397	
1398	instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
1399	  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance
1400	
1401	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` before G1 and G4 (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active
1402	(non-empty stack); each parameter is an active derived authority (`origin ≠ none`) held by the
1403	caller (A3, read since pass 2 without requiring the caller to be the deriving frame); the parent
1404	and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its parent. -/
1405	def EnterPreBase (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
1406	  s.F ≠ [] ∧
1407	  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
1408	    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
1409	  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
1410	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
1411	      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
1412	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True
1413	
1414	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
1415	    Decidable (EnterPreBase s ps ls) := by
1416	  unfold EnterPreBase; infer_instance
1417	
1418	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): those of `EnterPreBase`; G1: in
1419	`enterEff s ps ls`, the state where the new frame has received its parameters, the direct origin of
1420	every `Modify` parameter is exercisable at no mode (`ParamOriginHidden`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in
1421	the arrival state. -/
1422	def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
1423	  EnterPreBase s ps ls ∧ (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧
1424	    AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)
1425	
1426	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
1427	    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
1428	  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance
1429	
1430	/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
1431	def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
1432	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1433	  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

1435	/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A4, A5, A7) -/
1436	
1437	/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀`: active, and held by a holder still live once
1438	the frame is popped, through transitive ownership (A4, A5). A7 speaks of an authority held by
1439	a surviving frame; an authority held by a place is read as held by the frame that ends its
1440	owner chain. -/
1441	def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
1442	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False
1443	
1444	instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
1445	  unfold Survives; infer_instance
1446	
1447	/-- First surviving authority of a list (A7). -/
1448	def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
1449	  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)
1450	
1451	/-- Authority `a` after the exit (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): released unless it survives; a surviving
1452	authority is re-attached to its first surviving strict ancestor along `origin`, which is its
1453	origin when that origin survives. -/
1454	def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
1455	  if Survives s F₀ a then
1456	    match y.origin with
1457	    | none => y
1458	    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
1459	  else { y with active := false }
1460	
1461	/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A4; A5; A7): return to the caller; each anchor
1462	replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its ancestors; authorities that do
1463	not survive released; surviving derived authorities re-attached. -/
1464	def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
1465	  match s.F with
1466	  | _ :: F₀ =>
1467	    { s with
1468	      F := F₀
1469	      D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
1470	      A := mapI (exitG s F₀) 0 s.A }
1471	  | [] => s
1472	
1473	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7; B4): the exiting frame has a caller; every
1474	anchor of a place still usable after the exit has a surviving authority among itself and its
1475	ancestors along `origin`; every surviving derived authority has a surviving strict ancestor;
1476	B4: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame, transitively owned storage included, is
1477	pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival
1478	state, after the re-anchoring. Otherwise the exit is rejected. -/
1479	def ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
1480	  match s.F with
1481	  | _ :: F₀ => F₀ ≠ [] ∧
1482	      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
1483	        ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
1484	      (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s F₀ a → s.org a ≠ none →
1485	        firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
1486	      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
1487	        ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
1488	      AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)
1489	  | [] => False
1490	
1491	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) := by
1492	  unfold ExitPre; split <;> infer_instance
1493	
1494	/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O7). -/
1495	def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

1497	/-! ## Abstract reads and writes (MM-03.3 §5) -/
1498	
1499	/-- Ordinary read condition of a leaf by authority `a` (MM-03.3 §5, `canRead3`): an effective
1500	authority permits observation, the leaf is initialised, the needed dependencies are valid. The
1501	type and storage contract is not represented. -/
1502	def CanReadLeaf (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
1503	  effective s a p ≠ none ∧ s.I p = .init ∧ DepsValid s p
1504	
1505	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (CanReadLeaf s a p) :=
1506	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
1507	
1508	/-- `canRead3` (MM-03.3 §5): ordinary read of leaves `ls` by authority `a`, exercisable at
1509	`Observe` (B2). -/
1510	def canRead3 (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop :=
1511	  s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ ∀ p ∈ ls, CanReadLeaf s a p
1512	
1513	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (canRead3 s a ls) := by

1516	/-- `read3` as a relation (MM-03.3 §5): a read does not change the state. -/
1517	def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=

1520	/-- `canWrite3` (MM-03.3 §5): `a` exercisable at `Modify` (B2); on each leaf, effective
1521	`Modify` of `a` and needed dependencies valid. The clause "no other ordinary authority with an
1522	incompatible effective right" is removed (A11): it follows from the first under I1
1523	(`canWrite3_excl_redundant`). The type and storage condition is not represented. -/
1524	def canWrite3 (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop :=

1527	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (canWrite3 s a ls) := by
1528	  unfold canWrite3; infer_instance
1529	
1530	/-- Effect of a write (MM-03.3 §5): written leaves become `Init`. -/
1531	def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 := { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }
1532	
1533	/-- `write3` as a relation (MM-03.3 §5). -/

1537	/-! ## Lemmas on the effective authority (MM-03.3.5) -/
1538	
1539	theorem effOf_cases {m m' : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : effOf m ds = some m') :
1540	    (ds = [] ∧ m' = m) ∨ (ds ≠ [] ∧ Mode.modify ∉ ds ∧ m' = .observe) := by
1541	  unfold effOf at h
1542	  by_cases h0 : ds = []
1543	  · simp [h0] at h; exact .inl ⟨h0, h.symm⟩
1544	  · by_cases h1 : Mode.modify ∈ ds
1545	    · simp [h0, h1] at h
1546	    · simp [h0, h1] at h; exact .inr ⟨h0, h1, h.symm⟩
1547	
1548	theorem mode_eq_observe {m : Mode} (h : m ≠ .modify) : m = .observe := by cases m <;> simp_all
1549	
1550	theorem mem_descModes {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} :
1551	    m ∈ descModes s a p ↔ ∃ j y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧
1552	      a ∈ s.ancs j ∧ y.mode = m := by
1553	  simp only [descModes, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
1554	  constructor
1555	  · rintro ⟨j, -, h⟩
1556	    split at h
1557	    · rename_i y hy
1558	      split at h
1559	      · rename_i hc; cases h; exact ⟨j, y, hy, hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2, rfl⟩
1560	      · cases h
1561	    · cases h
1562	  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
1563	    refine ⟨j, (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hy).1, ?_⟩
